sentences.text:
Keshav Wadhwani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8
November, 2016
 Mcrc-19425-2016
 (Keshav Wadhwani Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
08-11-2016
 Shri Shobhit Aditya, counsel for the petitioner.

Heard on admission as well as I.A.No.21387/2016 for
staying the proceedings before the trial Court.

Relying upon the judgment rendered by the Supreme Court in the case of Girishbhai Dahyabhai Shah vs. C.C.Jani and another, 2010(1) EFR 652, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that authorities took five years to make sample available to the Court for being sent to C.F.L. as envisaged under section 13(2) of the Food Adulteration Act and as a consequence the sample was returned by the Central Food Laboratory with a report that the sample has become unfit for analysis.

entities.text: Girishbhai Dahyabhai Shah vs. C.C.Jani and another, 2010(1) EFR 652
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In aforesaid circumstances, let notice be issued to respondent no.1 Smt. Adlin E Panna, returnable in four weeks, by RAD as well as ordinary mode.
Let requisites for the same be filed within a week.
Let the matter be listed in the week commencing 13.12.2016.
Till next date of hearing, the proceedings in RCT No.8607/2011 pending before the Court of Shri Rakesh Kumar Patidar, Special Judge (Prevention of Food Adulteration Act), Bhopal shall remain stayed.

entities.text: Special Judge (Prevention of Food Adulteration Act), Bhopal
